description: View/Edit Mode Separation - Refactor the project workspace to prevent accidental edits by defaulting to View Mode and requiring intentional activation of Edit Mode.

userStories.title: Default to View Mode on Project Open
userStories.description: As a user, I want to open a project directly into View Mode so that I don't accidentally move or resize my aligned image.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a project routes to View Mode (no controls visible)
Image is displayed but not editable (pan/pinch/rotate gestures disabled)
Screen keeps awake while in View Mode
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed - projects now default to View Mode (projection mode) on open

userStories.title: Long-Press to Reveal Controls
userStories.description: As a user, I want to long-press (2 seconds) anywhere on the screen to reveal navigation controls so I can access options without accidentally editing.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-pressing anywhere for 2 seconds reveals control overlay
Controls fade in with animation
Controls include: 'Back' button (returns to project list) and 'Edit' button (enters Edit Mode)
Tapping outside controls or pressing a 'hide' button hides controls again
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed - 2-second long-press reveals animated controls with Back, Edit, Hide, and Reset buttons

userStories.title: Enter Edit Mode from Controls
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tap an 'Edit' button from the revealed controls to enter Edit Mode where I can manipulate the image.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Edit' button is visible in the revealed controls overlay
Tapping 'Edit' enters Edit Mode with full editing controls (undo, redo, reset)
Image editing gestures (pan, pinch, rotate) are enabled in Edit Mode
Edit Mode shows visual indicator (dashed border around image)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Verified - Edit button in controls triggers Edit Mode with undo/redo/reset controls, enabled gestures, and dashed border visual indicator

userStories.title: Exit Edit Mode to View Mode
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tap a 'Done' button to exit Edit Mode and return to View Mode so I can view my aligned image without risk of editing.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Done' button is visible in Edit Mode controls
Tapping 'Done' exits Edit Mode and returns to View Mode
Transform changes are saved before exiting Edit Mode
Controls are hidden upon returning to View Mode
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Verified - Done button in Edit Mode exits to View Mode, transforms are persisted on gesture end, controls hidden via setShowSecondaryControls(false)

userStories.title: Remove Legacy Unlock/Project Toggle
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the old 'Unlock/Project' toggle button that conflates View and Edit modes.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Unlock/Project' button is removed from WorkspaceControls.tsx
Related state (isProjectionMode toggle logic) is refactored to new mode system
No TypeScript errors
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Refactored isProjectionMode → isEditMode and onToggleProjection → onToggleEditMode across all workspace components. Legacy toggle terminology removed.

userStories.title: Move Reset Button to Edit Mode Only
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Reset button to only appear in Edit Mode so that I cannot accidentally reset my image alignment from the View Mode controls overlay.
acceptanceCriteria: Reset button is NOT visible in View Mode controls overlay (long-press reveal)
Reset button IS visible only when in Edit Mode
Reset functionality remains unchanged (resets image transform to default)
Confirmation dialog still appears before resetting
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed - Changed Reset button condition from showTopControls to isEditMode in WorkspaceControls.tsx. Reset now only visible in Edit Mode.
